academicYear.noSubjectsSubtitle: Add a subject from one of the semesters above to start organizing files

hero.title: Your academic year
hero.content: This shows the selected year's date range and quick stats: semesters, subjects, files indexed, and favorites.

semesters.title: Semesters
semesters.content: Semesters break your year into terms. Click one to open it, or add a new semester here.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.content: Every subject across this year's semesters shows up here. Click one to browse its folders and files, and star the ones you use often.

recent.title: Recently opened
recent.content: Files you've recently opened anywhere in this year appear here for quick access.

stats.title: Semester stats
stats.content: Quick counts for this semester: subjects, files indexed, exam-tagged files, and favorites.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.content: Click a subject to browse its folders and files, star the ones you care about, or add a new subject here.

recent.title: Recently opened
recent.content: Files you've recently opened anywhere in this semester show up here for quick access.

actions.title: Add content
actions.content: Import an existing OS folder to bring in all its files at once, or create a virtual folder to organize files inside the app.

folders.title: Folders
folders.content: Virtual folders live inside the app and group related files together. Click one to open it.

imported.title: Imported folders
imported.content: Imported folders mirror a real folder on your computer, including its subfolders, without moving or copying any files.

recent.title: Recently opened
recent.content: Files you've recently opened in this subject appear here, whether they live in a virtual folder or an imported one.

actions.title: Manage this folder
actions.content: Add more files, rename the folder, or delete it from here.

filters.title: Filter files
filters.content: Narrow the list down by file format or by the category tag assigned to each file.

files.title: Files
files.content: Hover a file to reveal its actions. The eye icon opens a side-by-side preview panel you can resize, without leaving this page; you can also open it in its default app, or delete it.

header.title: Imported folder
header.content: This mirrors a folder on your computer, shown at the path below. Its files aren't moved or copied — this is just a live view.

filters.title: Filter files
filters.content: Narrow the current folder's files down by format.

files.title: Browse files
files.content: Subfolders and files are listed together. Click a subfolder to navigate into it. Hover a file and click the eye icon to preview it in a resizable side-by-side panel, or open it directly.

header.title: Favorite subjects
header.content: Subjects you star show up here for quick access, no matter which year or semester they belong to.

list.title: Your favorites
list.content: Click a subject to jump straight into it, or click the star again to remove it from this list.
